# Config reference

Generated from `internal/config.Schema` — the same description the parser
validates against, so this table can never disagree with `holaclaw check`.

## `config.toml`

| Key | Type | Allowed values | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `backups` | table |  |  |  | the daemon's own backups (ARCHITECTURE.md §4) |
| `backups.every` | duration | Go duration string, e.g. "90s" | 24h |  | how often the daemon takes an automatic backup, e.g. "24h" |
| `backups.keep` | integer |  | 7 |  | automatic backups to keep, the oldest deleted first; 0 takes none. Backups somebody asked for are never deleted |
| `browser` | table |  |  |  | browser sidecar connection (docs/browser.md); absent = no browser unless $HOLACLAW_BROWSER_ENABLED is true |
| `browser.binary` | string |  |  |  | absolute path to the browser binary; default: discovered at runtime |
| `browser.enabled` | boolean |  | true |  | turn the browser on, giving every agent browser.do; $HOLACLAW_BROWSER_ENABLED wins |
| `browser.headless` | boolean |  | false |  | run without a visible window; default: a window on Xvfb |
| `browser.socket` | string |  | /run/holaclaw-browser/browser.sock |  | unix socket path where `holaclaw browser` listens |
| `models` | map-table |  |  |  | named model capability profiles |
| `models.<name>.api` | string | chat, decisions, images | chat |  | wire API this model speaks |
| `models.<name>.context` | integer |  |  |  | context window in tokens; required for a chat model, ignored otherwise |
| `models.<name>.id` | string |  |  | yes | model id on the wire |
| `models.<name>.provider` | string |  |  | yes | provider instance serving this model |
| `models.<name>.reasoning` | string | "", none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra |  |  | reasoning effort of every call that sets none: none turns thinking off, the others are passed through and the model may refuse one it does not support; unset = the model's default |
| `models.<name>.schema_profile` | string | "", llamacpp |  |  | strips grammar-hostile JSON-schema keywords |
| `models.<name>.strict` | boolean |  |  |  | promote text-leaked tool calls |
| `models.<name>.thinking_tags` | list<string> |  |  |  | extra reasoning-tag names to scrub |
| `models.<name>.timeout` | duration | Go duration string, e.g. "90s" |  |  | whole-request timeout, e.g. "120s" |
| `models.<name>.tools` | boolean |  |  |  | supports native tool calling |
| `models.<name>.url` | string |  |  |  | absolute endpoint override; required for a decisions model |
| `models.<name>.vision` | boolean |  |  |  | accepts image parts |
| `providers` | map-table |  |  |  | named provider connections |
| `providers.<name>.api_key` | string |  |  |  | `env:VAR` reference; literal secrets belong in auth.toml |
| `providers.<name>.auth` | string | none, api-key, subscription | none |  | auth strategy |
| `providers.<name>.base_url` | string |  |  |  | endpoint base URL |
| `providers.<name>.max_concurrent` | integer |  |  |  | in-flight request limit for this provider |
| `providers.<name>.sort` | string | throughput, latency, price |  |  | routing preference for a multi-provider gateway (OpenRouter provider.sort); throughput is the fast choice |
| `providers.<name>.type` | string | openai-compatible, codex |  | yes | compiled-in provider type |
| `retention` | table |  |  |  | how long traceability data is kept |
| `retention.events_days` | integer |  | 30 |  | days of trace events to keep; the ids of sent messages, which route reactions, are kept as long |
| `server` | table |  |  |  | control API and storage locations |
| `server.allow_insecure_transport` | boolean |  | false |  | serve an off-loopback listen over plain http, without TLS; a token is still required; $HOLACLAW_ALLOW_INSECURE_TRANSPORT wins |
| `server.data_dir` | string |  |  |  | directory holding the SQLite file and the blob store; relative to the config directory, which holds it by default |
| `server.listen` | string |  |  |  | optional TCP address; off-loopback needs a token and TLS; $HOLACLAW_LISTEN wins |
| `server.public_url` | string |  |  |  | the address devices reach the control API at, for pairing links; unset, they use listen unless it is loopback or a wildcard; $HOLACLAW_PUBLIC_URL wins |
| `server.secrets_dir` | string |  | /etc/holaclaw-secrets |  | absolute path of the directory holding auth.toml |
| `server.socket` | string |  |  |  | unix socket path for the control API |
| `server.tls_cert` | string |  |  |  | TLS certificate file for listen |
| `server.tls_key` | string |  |  |  | TLS key file for listen |
| `version` | integer |  |  | yes | config directory version |

## `connectors.toml`

| Key | Type | Allowed values | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `connectors` | map-table |  |  |  | named connectors; an id is [a-z0-9-], at most 32 characters |
| `connectors.<name>.allow_insecure_transport` | boolean |  | false |  | reach the server over plain http on any host, or https with a certificate that does not verify |
| `connectors.<name>.auth` | string | none, oauth |  | yes | how the daemon authenticates; tokens live in auth.toml |
| `connectors.<name>.client_id` | string |  |  |  | pre-registered client id, only for a server that requires one |
| `connectors.<name>.scopes` | list<string> |  |  |  | OAuth scopes to request; absent = every scope the server offers |
| `connectors.<name>.trusted` | boolean |  | false |  | results are still wrapped as untrusted content but never scored or arm the taint |
| `connectors.<name>.url` | string |  |  | yes | the server's Streamable HTTP endpoint |
| `version` | integer |  |  | yes | config directory version |

## Problem codes

Stable ids `holaclaw check` and `config.Load` report; never reused or
repurposed (see `internal/check/RULES.md`).

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| CFG001 | Unknown key, with a "did you mean" over the valid keys of that table |
| CFG002 | Key in the wrong file; the message names the right one |
| CFG003 | Wrong value type for the key |
| CFG004 | Value outside the allowed set for the key |
| CFG005 | Required key missing |
| CFG006 | Dangling reference: model to provider, role to model, channel to agent, agent to connector |
| CFG007 | `version` missing, not an integer, or not CurrentVersion |
| CFG008 | Files of one directory carry different versions |
| CFG009 | A literal secret where only an `env:VAR` reference is allowed |
| CFG010 | Unknown tool name (only checked by Validate, which knows the registry) |
| CFG011 | Malformed value: unparseable TOML, bad duration, non-positive count, a bad connector id or one that is a built-in tool or group name, a connector granted twice |
| CFG012 | Missing or unreadable file in the config directory |
